title: Tikal and the Petén: A Great Classic Maya City
goal: Describe who built and used Tikal, and what has been done since, with the passive with ser.
grammar: passive with ser + past participle + por

sections.title: Unit 4: Guatemala: the Maya, Highland Communities and Memory
body: This unit is about Guatemala: the Maya city of Tikal, the Popol Vuh, colonial Antigua, the armed conflict of 1960 to 1996 and how it is remembered, and community life in the highlands today.

The screens and instructions are in English; the texts and exercises are in Spanish. There is no new grammar here: each lesson uses a skill you already know to talk about Guatemala, and gives you the words you need for it.

items: I can say who built or did something with *ser* + participle + *por*.
I can describe Tikal and what happened to it.
I can explain how the people of Tikal collected water.
